name: scholialang
description: Scholialang plugin 0.7.2: local per-project auto-emit tracing, a structured-reasoning DAG, and validation of the stable Scholia v0.6.2 language grammar.

interface.shortDescription: Local structured-reasoning DAG + validator for Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Scholia helps agentic systems preserve reasoning state, use tools without quality loss, and reduce context cost across long-horizon work. Plugin release 0.7.2 lets Claude Code capture explicit reasoning as a local SQLite-backed DAG, lint snippets against the stable Scholia v0.6.2 language grammar, and query prior decisions for token-efficient recall across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Start a Scholialang trace for this project.
Lint this Scholia snippet against the stable Scholia v0.6.2 language grammar.
